title: Steelers rule out CB Brandin Echols, WR Ben Skowronek for Paris trip

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Steelers rule out CB Brandin Echols, WR Ben Skowronek for Paris trip
sources.description: The Steelers have ruled out cornerback Brandin Echols (hamstring) and wide receiver Ben Skowronek (calf) for Sunday's game against the Saints.
